٦١٢٣ — عن أبي هريرة قال: قال النبي ﷺ: (( أيما رجل أعتق امرأً مسلما، استنقذ اللّٰه بكل عضو منه عضوا منه من النار )). قال سعيد بن مرجانة: فانطلقت به إلى علي بن حسين، فعمد علي بن حسين -رضي اللّه عنهما- إلى عبد له قد أعطاه به عبد اللّٰه بن جعفر عشرة آلاف درهم أو ألف دينار، فأعتقه.

متفق عليه: رواه البخاري (٢٥١٧)، ومسلم (٢٤ : ١٥٠٩). ورواه أحمد (٩٤٤١)، وابن الجارود (٩٦٨)، والبيهقي (٢٧٣/٦) من طريق آخر وزاد فيه: (( حتى إنه ليعتق باليد اليدَ، وبالرجل الرجلَ، وبالفرج الفرجَ) ).

6123 — Abu Hurayrah said: The Prophet ﷺ said, “Whoever frees a Muslim slave, Allah will save from the Fire a limb of his for every limb of that slave.” Sa‘id ibn Marjanah said: I took this report to ‘Ali ibn al-Husayn, and ‘Ali ibn al-Husayn — may Allah be pleased with them both — went to a slave of his for whom ‘Abd Allah ibn Ja‘far had offered him ten thousand dirhams or one thousand dinars, and he set him free.

Agreed upon: Narrated by al-Bukhari (2517) and Muslim (1509:24). Ahmad (9441), Ibn al-Jarud (968), and al-Bayhaqi (6/273) narrated it through another chain and added: “So much so that for the hand he frees a hand, for the foot a foot, and for the private part the private part.”

٦١٢٤ — عن أبي نجيح السلمي (هو عمرو بن عبسة) قال: حاصرنا مع رسول اللّٰه ﷺ بقصر الطائف - قال معاذ: سمعت أبي يقول: بقصر الطائف، بحصن الطائف، كل ذلك - فسمعت رسول اللّٰه ﷺ يقول: (( من بلغ بسهم فى سبيل اللّٰه عز وجل فله درجة )). وساق الحديث. وسمعت رسول اللّٰه ﷺ يقول: (( أيما رجل مسلم أعتق رجلا مسلما فإن اللّٰه عز وجل جاعل وقاء كل عظم من عظامه عظما من عظام محرَّره من النار. وأيما امرأة أعتقت امرأة مسلمة فإن اللّٰه جاعل وقاء كل عظم من عظامها عظما من عظام محررها من النار يوم القيامة )).

صحيح: رواه أبو داود (٣٩٦٥)، والترمذي (١٦٣٨) وصحّحه، والنسائي (٣١٤٣)، وصحّحه ابن حبان (٤٦١٥).

6124 — Abu Najih al-Sulami, who is ‘Amr ibn ‘Abasah, said: We laid siege with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at the fortress of al-Ta’if. Mu‘adh said: I heard my father say, “At the palace of al-Ta’if,” “at the fortress of al-Ta’if” — all of that was said. I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, “Whoever causes an arrow to reach its mark in the cause of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will have one degree for it.” Then he mentioned the rest of the narration. And I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, “Any Muslim man who frees a Muslim man, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will make each bone of the freed person a protection for each bone of his from the Fire. And any Muslim woman who frees a Muslim woman, Allah will make each bone of the freed woman a protection for each bone of her from the Fire on the Day of Resurrection.”

Authentic: Narrated by Abu Dawud (3965), al-Tirmidhi (1638), who authenticated it, al-Nasa’i (3143), and Ibn Hibban, who authenticated it (4615).

٦١٢٥ — عن أبي أمامة وغيره من أصحاب النبي ﷺ، عن النبي ﷺ قال: (( أيما امرئ مسلم أعتق امرأ مسلما كان فكاكه من النار، يجزي كل عضو منه عضوا منه. وأيما امرئ مسلم أعتق امرأتين مسلمتين كانتا فكاكه من النار، يجزي كل عضو منهما عضوا منه. وأيما امرأة مسلمة أعتقت امرأة مسلمة كانت فكاكها من النار، يجزي كل عضو منها عضوا منها)).

حسن: رواه الترمذي (١٥٤٧).

Any Muslim man who frees two Muslim women, they will be his ransom from the Fire; each limb of the two will count for one of his limbs. And any Muslim woman who frees a Muslim woman, she will be her ransom from the Fire; each limb of the freed woman will count for one of her limbs.”

Hasan: Narrated by al-Tirmidhi (1547).

٦١٢٨ — عن البراء قال: جاء أعرابي إلى النبي ﷺ، فقال: يا رسول الله، أخبرني بعمل يدخلني الجنة. قال: (( لئن قصَّرت في الخطبة لقد عرضت المسألة، أعتق النسمة وفك الرقبة )). قال: يا رسول الله، أوما هما سواء؟ قال: (( لا، عتق النسمة أن تفرد بها، وفك الرقبة أن تعين في ثمنها، والمنحة الوكوف، والفيء على ذي الرحم الظالم )). قال: فمن لم يطق ذلك؟ قال: (( فأطعم الجائع، واسق الظمآن )). قال: فإن لم أستطع؟ قال: (( مر بالمعروف، وانه عن المنكر )). قال: فمن لم يطق ذاك؟ قال: (( فكف لسانك إلا من خير )).

صحيح: رواه أحمد (١٨٦٤٧)، وأبو داود الطيالسي (٧٧٥)، والبخاري في الأدب المفرد (٦٩)، وابن حبان (٣٧٤).

6128 — Al-Bara’ said: A Bedouin came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, tell me of a deed that will admit me into Paradise. He said, “Though you made the speech brief, you have put the question clearly. Free a person from bondage and help free another from bondage.” He said: O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, are they not the same? He said: “No. Freeing a person from bondage means that you do it by yourself entirely, while helping free a person means that you assist in paying his price. Also, lending a milking animal, and showing kindness to a relative even when he is oppressive.” He said: What if I cannot do that? He said: “Then feed the hungry and give drink to the thirsty.” He said: What if I cannot? He said: “Then command what is right and forbid what is wrong.” He said: What if I cannot do that? He said: “Then restrain your tongue from everything except good.”

Authentic: Narrated by Ahmad (18647), Abu Dawud al-Tayalisi (775), al-Bukhari in al-Adab al-Mufrad (69), and Ibn Hibban (374).

٦١٣١ — عن أبي هريرة قال: قال رسول اللّٰه ﷺ: (( لا يجزي ولد والدا إلا أن يجده مملوكا، فيشتريه، فيُعتقه )).

صحيح: رواه مسلم (١٥١٠).

6131 — Abu Hurayrah said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, “A child cannot fully repay his parent except if he finds him enslaved, buys him, and sets him free.”

Authentic: Narrated by Muslim (1510).

His statement, “then he buys him and frees him,” means that emancipation takes effect immediately upon purchase, and no separate declaration of freedom is needed. A separate declaration would imply that the parent remained under his ownership for some period if he wished, and no scholar has said that a father remains owned by his child until the child later frees him.

صحيح: رواه مسلم (١٥١٠).

وقوله: (( فيشتريه، فيعتقه )) أي يقع العتق بالشراء مباشرة، ولا يحتاج إلى إنشاء العتق، فإن إنشاء العتق يستلزم إبقاءه تحت ملكه أيضًا إن شاء، ولم يقل أحد من أهل العلم أن يكون الأب مملوكًا لولده حتى يعتقه.

6131 — Abu Hurayrah said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, “A child cannot fully repay his parent except if he finds him enslaved, buys him, and sets him free.”

Authentic: Narrated by Muslim (1510).

His statement, “then he buys him and frees him,” means that emancipation takes effect immediately upon purchase, and no separate declaration of freedom is needed. A separate declaration would imply that the parent remained under his ownership for some period if he wished, and no scholar has said that a father remains owned by his child until the child later frees him.

٦١٣٢ — عن أبي ذر قال: سألت النبي ﷺ أي العمل أفضل؟ قال: (( إيمان بالله، وجهاد في سبيله )). قلت: فأي الرقاب أفضل؟ قال: (( أعلاها ثمنا، وأنفسها عند أهلها )). قلت: فإن لم أفعل؟ قال: (( تُعين صانعا، أو تصنع لأخرق )). قال: فإن لم أفعل؟ قال: (( تدع الناس من الشر، فإنها صدقة تصدق بها على نفسك )).

متفق عليه: رواه البخاري (٢٥١٨)، ومسلم (٨٤ :١٣٦).

6132 — Abu Dharr said: I asked the Prophet ﷺ: Which deed is best? He said, “Faith in Allah and striving in His path.” I said: Then which slaves are best to free? He said, “Those most expensive in price and most precious to their owners.” I said: What if I cannot do that? He said: “Help a worker, or work on behalf of one who is unskilled.” He said: What if I cannot do that? He said: “Then refrain from harming people, for that is a charity you give on your own behalf.”

Agreed upon: Narrated by al-Bukhari (2518) and Muslim (136:84).

Otherwise, the portion already freed remains free.”

Agreed upon: Narrated by Malik (1), al-Bukhari (2522), and Muslim (1501:1 and 1501:47).

Authentic: Narrated by al-Bukhari (2525).

٦١٤٠ — عن أبي هريرة أن النبي ﷺ قال: (( من أعتق نصيبا، أو شقيصا في مملوك فخلاصه عليه في ماله إن كان له مال، وإلا قُوِّم عليه، فاستسعي به غير مشقوق عليه )).

متفق عليه: رواه البخاري (٢٥٢٧)، ومسلم (٣:١٥٠٣). وقوله: (( شقيصا)) أي بعضه.

والمعنى أنه إذا كان المعتق موسرًا لزمه أداء قيمة نصيب شريكه، فيعتق العبد كله، وإن لم يكن له مال قُوِّم العبد واستُسعي في قيمة نصيب الشريك غير مشقوق عليه.

english_source:
6140 — Abu Hurayrah narrated that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever frees a share, or a portion, in a slave, then the completion of his freedom is due from his wealth if he has wealth. Otherwise, the slave is fairly valued, and he is required to work to earn his freedom without hardship being imposed on him.”

Agreed upon: Narrated by al-Bukhari (2527) and Muslim (1503:3). His statement, “or a portion,” means part of him.

The meaning is that if the emancipating partner has sufficient wealth, he must pay the fair value of his co-owner’s share, and the slave becomes fully free. If he does not have sufficient wealth, the slave is fairly valued and required to work toward paying the value of the remaining share, without undue hardship.

٦١٤١ — عن سلمان قال: كاتبت أهلي على أن أغرس لهم خمس مائة فسيلة، فإذا علِقت فأنا حر. قال: فأتيت النبي ﷺ، فذكرت ذلك له، فقال: (( اغرس، واشترط لهم، فإذا أردت أن تغرس فآذني)). قال: فآذنته. قال: فجاء، فجعل يغرس بيده إلا واحدة، غرستها بيدي، فعلقن إلا الواحدة.

6141 — Salman said: I made a contract with my masters that I would plant five hundred date-palms for them, and when they took root I would be free. He said: I came to the Prophet ﷺ and mentioned that to him. He said, “Plant them, and make the condition for them. When you want to plant them, inform me.” He said: So I informed him. He came and began planting them with his own hand, except for one which I planted with my own hand. They all took root except that one.

Hasan: Narrated by Ahmad (23730), al-Hakim (2/217–218), and al-Bayhaqi (10/321).

6142 — ‘Amr ibn Shu‘ayb narrated from his father, from his grandfather, from the Prophet ﷺ that he said: “The contract slave remains a slave as long as even one dirham remains from his contracted amount.”

In another wording: “Any slave who contracts for one hundred ounces and pays all but ten ounces is still a slave; and any slave who contracts for one hundred dinars and pays all but ten dinars is still a slave.”

Hasan: Narrated by Abu Dawud (3926, 3927), al-Tirmidhi (1260), Ibn Majah (2519), and Ahmad (6666).

6146 — ‘Urwah said: ‘A’ishah told him that Barirah came to ‘A’ishah seeking her help with her contract of emancipation, and she had not yet paid anything of it. ‘A’ishah said to her: Return to your family; if they wish that I settle your contract for you and your clientship be mine, I will do so. ٦١٥٤ — عن علي بن أبي طالب قال: ما عندنا شيء إلا كتاب الله، وهذه الصحيفة عن النبي ﷺ: (( المدينة حرم ما بين عائر إلى كذا، من أحدث فيها حدثا، أو آوى محدثا فعليه لعنة اللّٰه والملائكة والناس أجمعين، لا يقبل منه صرف ولا عدل )).

وقال: (( ذمة المسلمين واحدة، فمن أخفر مسلما، فعليه لعنة اللّٰه والملائكة والناس أجمعين، لا يقبل منه صرف، ولا عدل، ومن تولى قوما بغير إذن مواليه فعليه لعنة اللّٰه والملائكة والناس أجمعين، لا يقبل منه صرف ولا عدل )).

متفق عليه: رواه البخاري (١٨٧٠)، ومسلم (٢٠ :١٣٧٠). والسياق للبخاري.

6154 — ‘Ali ibn Abi Talib said: We have nothing except the Book of Allah and this document from the Prophet ﷺ: “Madinah is a sanctuary between ‘Air and such-and-such. Whoever introduces an innovation in it or shelters an innovator, upon him is the curse of Allah, the angels, and all people together. No compulsory act nor voluntary ransom will be accepted from him.”

And he said: “The protection granted by the Muslims is one. Whoever violates the protection of a Muslim, upon him is the curse of Allah, the angels, and all people together. No compulsory act nor voluntary ransom will be accepted from him. And whoever affiliates himself with a people without the permission of his patrons, upon him is the curse of Allah, the angels, and all people together. No compulsory act nor voluntary ransom will be accepted from him.”

Agreed upon: Narrated by al-Bukhari (1870) and Muslim (1370:20). The wording is that of al-Bukhari.

6156 — Abu Hurayrah narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever affiliates himself with a people without the permission of his patrons, upon him is the curse of Allah and the angels. No voluntary ransom nor obligatory compensation will be accepted from him.”

Authentic: Narrated by Muslim (1508:18).

6157 — Jabir ibn ‘Abd Allah said: A man from the Ansar declared that his slave would be free after his death, and he had no wealth other than him. That reached the Prophet ﷺ, so he said: “Who will buy him from me?” Nu‘aym ibn ‘Abd Allah bought him for eight hundred dirhams, and he handed the money to the man. ‘Amr said: I heard Jabir ibn ‘Abd Allah say: He was a Coptic slave who died the previous year.

٦١٥٨ — عن جابر قال: أعتق رجل من بني عُذْرة عبدا له عن دبر، فبلغ ذلك رسول اللّٰه ﷺ فقال: (( ألك مال غيره؟ )). فقال: لا. فقال: (( من يشتريه مني؟ )). فاشتراه نعيم بن عبد اللّٰه العدوي بثمانمائة درهم، فجاء بها رسول اللّٰه ﷺ، فدفعها إليه، ثم قال: (( ابدأ بنفسك، فتصدق عليها؛ فإن فضل شيء فلأهلك، فإن فضل عن أهلك شيء فلذي قرابتك، فإن فضل عن ذي قرابتك شيء فهكذا وهكذا )). يقول: فبين يديك، وعن يمينك، وشمالك.

صحيح: رواه مسلم (٩٩٧)، والبخاري (٢٥٣٤) لأصل القصة.

6158 — Jabir said: A man from Banu ‘Udhrah declared his slave free after his death. That reached the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so he said: “Do you have any wealth besides him?” He said: No. He said: “Who will buy him from me?” Nu‘aym ibn ‘Abd Allah al-‘Adawi bought him for eight hundred dirhams. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ brought the money and handed it to him, then said: “Begin with yourself and spend in charity on it. If anything remains, then it is for your family. If anything remains beyond your family, then for your relatives. If anything remains beyond your relatives, then like this and like this,” meaning in front of you, to your right, and to your left.

Authentic: Narrated by Muslim (997), with al-Bukhari (2534) reporting the core incident.

٦١٥٩ — عن جابر بن عبد اللّٰه يقول: كنا نبيع سرارينا، وأمهات أولادنا، والنبي ﷺ فينا، لا نرى بذلك بأسا.

صحيح: رواه عبدالرزاق (١٣٢١١)، وعنه أحمد (١٤٤٤٦)، وابن ماجه (٢٥١٧)، وابن حبان (٤٣٢٣).

6159 — Jabir ibn ‘Abd Allah said: We used to sell our slave women and the slave mothers of our children while the Prophet ﷺ was among us, and we saw no harm in that.

Authentic: Narrated by ‘Abd al-Razzaq (13211), from him Ahmad (14446), Ibn Majah (2517), and Ibn Hibban (4323).

Abu Dawud (3950) also narrated it through another route from Jabir ibn ‘Abd Allah, who said: We sold slave mothers during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and Abu Bakr, but when ‘Umar came, he forbade us, so we stopped.

6161 — Hakim ibn Hizam reported that he freed one hundred slaves in the pre-Islamic period and provided one hundred camels for riding. Then when he accepted Islam, he again provided one hundred camels and freed one hundred slaves. He said: So I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, what do you think of things I used to do in the pre-Islamic period by which I sought devotion, meaning acts of righteousness? متفق عليه: رواه البخاري (٢٥٤١)، ومسلم (١٧٣٠)، والسياق للبخاري.

He killed their fighters, took their children captive, and Juwayriyyah was taken that day. ‘Abd Allah ibn ‘Umar told me this, and he was in that army.

Agreed upon: Narrated by al-Bukhari (2541) and Muslim (1730). The wording here is that of al-Bukhari.

٦١٦٤ — عن أبي هريرة أنه لما أقبل يريد الإسلام، ومعه غلامه، ضل كل واحد منهما من صاحبه، فأقبل بعد ذلك، وأبو هريرة جالس مع النبي ﷺ، فقال النبي ﷺ: (( يا أبا هريرة، هذا غلامك قد أتاك )). فقال: أما إني أشهدك أنه حر. قال فهو حين يقول:

يا ليلةً من طولها وعنائها

على أنها من دارة الكفر نجت

6164 — Abu Hurayrah reported that when he was coming intending to accept Islam, and his servant was with him, each of them lost the other. Later the servant came while Abu Hurayrah was sitting with the Prophet ﷺ, and the Prophet ﷺ said: “O Abu Hurayrah, this is your servant; he has come to you.” So he said: I make you my witness that he is free. Then he began reciting:

“What a night of its length and hardship,

yet it has been saved from the abode of disbelief.”

Authentic: Narrated by al-Bukhari (2530).

6166 — Abu Hurayrah said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The child of fornication is the worst of the three.” Abu Hurayrah said: That I provide a whip for use in the path of Allah is more beloved to me than that I free a child born of fornication.

٦١٦٨ — عن سفينة أبي عبد الرحمن قال: أعتقتني أم سلمة، فاشترطتْ عليَّ أن أخدم النبي ﷺ ما عاش.

حسن: رواه أبو داود (٣٩٣٢)، وابن ماجه (٢٥٢٦)، وأحمد (٢١٩٢٧)، والحاكم (٢/٢١٣-٢١٤).

الشرط على قسمين:

شرط يفي به العبد، سواء اشترط، أو لم يشترط، فقد روي عن سفينة قال: كنت مملوكا لأم سلمة فقالت: أعتقك، وأشترط عليك أن تخدم رسول اللّٰه ﷺ ما عشت. فقلت: إن لم تشترطي عليَّ ما فارقت رسول اللّٰه ﷺ ما عشت، فأعتقتني.

وشرط مخالف لحرية العبد، مثل أن يشترط أن يدفع كل شهر كذا من المال ما عاش، وأن لا يتزوج. فهذا شرط فاسد، سواء قبل، أو لم يقبل، وهو بمجرد النطق بالحرية يكون حرا، وليس عليه الوفاء بهذا الشرط؛ لأن الأصل في الإنسان الحرية. (انظر شرح السنة ٧٧/٩).

6168 — Safinah Abu ‘Abd al-Rahman said: Umm Salamah freed me, but stipulated that I would serve the Prophet ﷺ as long as he lived.

Hasan: Narrated by Abu Dawud (3932), Ibn Majah (2526), Ahmad (21927), and al-Hakim (2/213–214).

Conditions are of two kinds:

A condition that the slave would fulfill whether it was stipulated or not. It is reported from Safinah that he said: I was owned by Umm Salamah, and she said: I free you, but I stipulate that you serve the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as long as you live. So I said: Even if you did not make that condition upon me, I would never leave the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as long as I lived. So she freed me.

And a condition that conflicts with the freedom of the slave, such as stipulating that he must pay a certain amount of money every month for life, or that he may not marry. This is an invalid condition whether he accepts it or not. Once freedom is declared, he becomes free immediately, and he is not required to fulfill such a condition, because the basic rule regarding a human being is freedom. (See Sharh al-Sunnah, 9/77).

6170 — Mu‘awiyah ibn Suwayd said: I slapped a servant of ours, so I fled. Then I returned shortly before noon and prayed behind my father. He called him and called me, then said: Let him retaliate against you. But the servant forgave me. Then he said: We, the family of Muqarrin, only had one servant during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and one of us slapped her. That reached the Prophet ﷺ, so he said: “Free her.” They said: They have no servant besides her. He said: “Then let them employ her, and when they no longer need her, let them set her free.”

The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him: “What is the matter with you?” He said: My master saw me kissing a slave-girl of his, so he cut off my private parts.
